Fry 6 slices pancetta in a dry pan for 4 minutes until crisp, drain and crumble. Halve the eggs, mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp white vinegar, salt and pepper. s.n: Bronx devilled eggs with crisp pancetta
s.note: Jammy-yolked eggs piped with mustard and mayo filling, topped with crisp pancetta, paprika and chives.
s.how: Lower 6 eggs into boiling water, cook 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel. Fry 6 slices pancetta in a dry pan for 4 minutes until crisp, drain and crumble. Halve the eggs, mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp white vinegar, salt and pepper. Pipe or spoon back into the whites. Top with pancetta, smoked paprika and snipped chives.

s.note: Chilled poached prawns with sharp horseradish cocktail sauce.
s.how: Poach 500g peeled green prawns in salted water for 2 minutes and chill in iced water. Mix 150ml tomato sauce with 2 tsp horseradish and the juice of 1 lemon. Serve the prawns on ice with the sauce and lemon wedges.

m.note: Dry-brined porterhouse, seared hard and butter basted with garlic.
m.how: Salt 2 porterhouse steaks, about 600g each, and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Sear in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, then add 50g butter, 3 crushed garlic cloves and a few thyme sprigs and baste until 52C inside. Rest 8 minutes and slice off the bone to share.

w.note: Baked lemon and vanilla ricotta cake dusted with icing sugar.
w.how: Drain 750g fresh ricotta for 2 hours. Beat with 150g caster sugar, 4 eggs, the zest of 1 lemon and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Pour into a lined 22cm springform tin and bake at 160C for 60 minutes, then cool in the oven with the door ajar. Dust with icing sugar.
